The solvers use it only as the loop bound (for iteration in range(start_iteration, max_iterations), serial 44d9c23c:110, parallel aed4dd59:196), so a route A converging at iteration n computes the same arrays with any budget > n.  Reason for 32 (CHECK_V001 M1): measured prefixes converged at iterations 4/5/6 (K=2/3/4) with the late contraction ratio rising (G4: 0.45 -> 0.66; signed step projection mu 0.45 -> 0.57, cos 0.95: a monotone slow mode, analysis/ROUTE_A_MODE_V001.json); the pessimistic G6 projection (analysis/ESTIMATES_V001.json) reaches residual/bound 1.14 at index 13 with ratios about 0.95, i.e. about 1.03 at index 15, not converged within 16; a 16-iteration checkpoint cannot be resumed with a larger budget (max_iterations is in the checkpoint identity controls), so the budget is set to the ceiling before the first call. context_not_used_by_the_decision: A21 (qinf_dependence_c2/QINF_DEPENDENCE_V001.md): the lapse response Q(k) = T k^2 c^4/(4 pi G) tends to Qinf = c^4/(16 pi G gamma_eff) with ~1/k^2 corrections (Q(0.3)=7.955, Q(1)=8.053, Q(2)=8.0598, limit 8.0623), so above k ~ 2/kpc the response itself is flat to < 0.04%; the K dependence measured here is carried by what the outer panels add to the field, not by a changing response.  Reported for reading the outcome; not used by X1-X4.
